cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 67% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.37% · WTI -1.58% · Brent -4.60% · NatGas +4.51%. 67% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.24%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.24%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -2.13%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: PWR is the standout at +6.04%
cards.body: Leaders: PWR +6.04%, EOSE +5.60%, LNG +5.39%, VRT +3.52%, BWXT +3.05%. Laggards: FTI -5.89%, MPC -4.10%, EQT -2.47%, NXE -2.29%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
